name: material_quantities
description: Material takeoff (pure read): per-material area in m2 and volume in m3 aggregated across the whole model, a single category, or the current selection. Returns material name, class, area_m2, volume_m3 and element_count sorted by area, plus totals. Counts geometry materials only (paint excluded). Simplified from the C# original: one category filter instead of a list, and per-material element id lists dropped to keep responses small.

params.name: category
params.description: Optional category filter: a BuiltInCategory name like 'OST_Walls' or a plain name like 'Walls'. Empty scans all model elements.

params.name: selected_only
params.description: Only analyze the elements currently selected in Revit. Combines with category.
